def fit(cols,names):
    A=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    r=dP_dt-A@c
    return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt), dict(zip(names,np.round(c,4)))

def equation(t, P, params):

    s=np.sqrt(P)
    b0 = p[0]/P + p[1]/s + p[2] + p[3]*s + p[4]*P + p[5]*P**1.5 + p[6]*P**2 + p[7]*P**3
